sloka: अजानतः शयानस्य क्रोधेन कलुषीकृतः ।मुक्तवान्मयि शापाग्निं यमदण्डमिवापरम् ।। ७.५५.१९ ॥
transliteration: ajānataḥ śayānasya krodhena kaluṣīkṛtaḥ ।muktavānmayi śāpāgniṁ yamadaṇḍamivāparam ।। 7.55.19 ॥

translations.english: Enraged by anger, he, unaware of me sleeping, cast upon me the fire of a curse, like a second rod of Yama.
